diagnosis.summary: The candidate implements a one-shot sequence (period 0) instead of a repeating cycle with period 3 MIN. The IR specifies a cycle that repeats the body (Siren call, 10s delay, Switch off) every 3 minutes indefinitely. The candidate executes the actions once and then delays for 3 minutes before terminating, failing to repeat the cycle body.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed period to 180000 (3 MIN) to match the IR cycle period. Rewrote the script to be a blocking repeating body without a final delay, ensuring the actions repeat on every iteration as required by the IR cycle semantics.
